proved_inference: For fixed rational tau, the arbitrary-law strict no-tau-pivot slab supremum equals the countable supremum over rational matrices with s3>1, rational intervals, and product indicators formed from finitely many common rational grid cells of total length one per coordinate. The same holds with affine leakage. At tau=1/16, the supplied no-pivot synthesis gives C_full <= max(4+185.125541062234134*C_grid, 732.284258667509562).
counterexample_localization: If full QFORM essential boundedness fails under the supplied no-pivot reduction, then for every N there is a finite rational strict no-1/16-pivot grid-product witness with slab ratio>N.
unresolved_implication: Prove a dimension-, mesh-, support-radius-, translation-, gap- and fragment-count-independent linear slab estimate on the strict no-1/16-pivot rational grid extreme-product class, or construct a diverging sequence inside that class.
